items.title: Although he shot 1 for 6 from 3 for 3 points, #Magic forward Tristan da Silva was a game-high +22 in 30 mins. Saturday with 5 AST and 3 REB to help Germany win the DBB SuperCup final 96-87 vs. Croatia.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
Although he shot 1 for 6 from 3 for 3 points, #Magic forward Tristan da Silva was a game-high +22 in 30 mins. Saturday with 5 AST and 3 REB to help Germany win the DBB SuperCup final 96-87 vs. Croatia.

Germany plays the Netherlands on Thursday in a FIBA World Cup Qualifier.

items.title: #Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 13 points on 2 for 3 shooting from 3-point range with 4 rebounds and 3 assists during 20 minutes in a 115-82 win vs. Czech Republic in a DBB SuperCup semifinal Friday in Hamburg.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic forward Tristan da Silva recorded 13 points on 2 for 3 shooting from 3-point range with 4 rebounds and 3 assists during 20 minutes in a 115-82 win vs. Czech Republic in a DBB SuperCup semifinal Friday in Hamburg.

Germany faces Croatia in the DBB SuperCup final Saturday.
